memory_candidates.content: When porting agent systems from .claude/ to .opencode/, extension agents (neovim, nix) have their prompt files in .opencode/extensions/{ext}/agents/, NOT in .opencode/agent/subagents/. Only core agents live in .opencode/agent/subagents/. This distinction is critical for opencode-agents.json prompt path references.
